notes: The navbar becomes a live dashboard: the title row now shows the machine itself — CPU %, system RAM %, tagent's own RSS, sampled every 2 s (a PerfSampler built on os.cpus() deltas that recomputes on read after a laptop suspend, so the numbers never go stale), rendered into the free dash-space of the box border and hard-truncated on both sides so the row stays exactly terminal-wide — the v0.31.1 sticky-math lesson applied from the start. And the context bar now works for EVERY provider: unknown models and custom providers used to resolve a context window of 0, which hid the bar entirely — the display now falls back to an assumed 128k window (marked "~128k"), estimated usage is marked "~" too, while TAGENT_CONTEXT_WINDOW and every real catalog/registry value always win. The bar also survives narrow terminals: a long custom model id shrinks before the bar is crowded out, the navbar footer drops ws/model/mcp segments before it — mode · bar · clock live at every width — and /stats grows a machine row of its own.
